# Best home backup power stations under $1,000

For most people I'd pick the **Anker SOLIX C2000 Gen 2** at about $900. It has 2,048 Wh, 2,400 W output, a 10 ms UPS switchover, and it can add a battery later. A fridge, CPAP and router would run about 23 hours on it, by Outage Authority's estimate. [Outage Authority roundup](https://outageauthority.com/roundups/best-power-station-home-backup)

## Top picks

| Pick | Capacity / output | Price | Best for |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Anker SOLIX C2000 Gen 2** | 2,048 Wh / 2,400 W | ~$899.99 | Best all-round; expandable to 4 kWh with a BP2000 pack |
| **Bluetti Elite 200 V2** | 2,074 Wh / 2,600 W | $899 to $1,199 (see note) | Longest rated life (6,000 cycles), if the price is right |
| **Bluetti AC180** | 1,152 Wh / 1,800 W | $499 | Best value; most Wh per dollar under $500 |
| **Jackery Explorer 1000 v2** | 1,070 Wh / 1,500 W | $489 at Outbound Power | Lightest (23.8 lb), for overnight outages |
| **Anker SOLIX F1500** | 1,536 Wh | $599.99 | Cheapest per Wh in one list, but I only found it there |

**Where to buy:**
- Anker C2000 Gen 2: [Outage Outfitter's page](https://outageoutfitter.com/best/under-1000/) links to Amazon, and [Outage Authority](https://outageauthority.com/roundups/best-power-station-home-backup) does too.
- Bluetti AC180: [Bluetti's official US store via Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-ac180). It's an affiliate link and costs you nothing extra. Dealectric says code **AFF5OFF** took $24.95 off in a cart test, to $474.05, but the store's checkout has the final word. [Details](https://dealectric.com/bluetti-ac180)
- Bluetti Elite 200 V2 and Jackery Explorer 1000 v2: use the "Check price" buttons on [Outage Authority](https://outageauthority.com/roundups/best-power-station-home-backup) and the [Jackery review](https://outageauthority.com/reviews/jackery-explorer-1000-v2). The Jackery's $489 is Outbound Power's price, since Jackery's own store now charges $559.

## Caveats
- **Elite 200 V2 prices conflict.** Two sources list it at $899 ([Compare Power Stations](https://comparepowerstations.com/best/best-under-1000/), [Outage Outfitter](https://outageoutfitter.com/best/under-1000/)). Outage Authority says Bluetti ended its promotion and the price went back to $1,199, though Amazon was $798.99 on Oct 7. Check the live price before buying. Under about $900 it's a great buy, and above $1,000 it's out of your budget.
- **No expansion on the Elite 200 V2, AC180 or Jackery 1000 v2.** The AC180 can only be topped up from a Bluetti B80/B230/B300 battery. The C2000 Gen 2 is the one that grows.
- **Runtimes are estimates.** They come from the manufacturers' specs, not independent lab tests. Outage Outfitter says it hasn't tested the units itself.
- **Appliance size matters.** A window AC, space heater or well pump needs the higher-output 2 kWh units, not the 1 kWh class.
- **The Bluetti Elite 100 V2 ($499) at [Home Depot](https://www.homedepot.com/p/337557774)** was out of stock when the page was captured.

If you tell me what you need to run (fridge, CPAP, window AC, etc.) and how long outages last where you live, I can narrow this to one pick.
